contents.text: Pegasus is a system that allows fast travel for a player's rideable mobs
To start, craft a pegasus feather by alternating feathers and apples in a checkerdboard pattern in a crafting table.
while riding a rideable mob, rightclick while holding the feather. This will link that animal to that particular feather.
Once that animal has been linked, it can be summoned to your location, or sent back to it's stable by right clicking the feather.

Care must be taken not to lose the mob. When summoning mobs with the feather, these are taken from the stable, if a player leaves there ride somewhere without sending them back to the stable, the feather won't be able to summon them.
